title: Indus River System Authority Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Indus River System Authority Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2000
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2000
INDUS RIVER SYSTEM AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
An Ordinance further to amend the
Indus River System Authority Act, 1992
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th September, 2000]
No.F.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated 4-9-2000.---The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Indus
River System Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
